messages:
anika: Quick bring-up on dev-stg for raptor-9b-lite. Doing a very small sanity sweep before we try int8. pinging @matt @sophia for any immediate red flags.

matt: thanks — can you drop the exact sanity prompts + the config you used? also curious about batch size / seq len for this run.

anika: yep. used tiny prompt set (3 prompts) and single-request batching. seq_len cap 512, batch=1. CURL I ran: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://devstg.api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"raptor-9b-lite","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.","max_new_tokens":64}'
```

anika: prompts: 
- "Summarize: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."
- "Translate to French: How are you today?"
- "What is 12 * 12?"

sophia: quick glance — short natural language prompts look fine. arithmetic one returned `144` but with an extra trailing sentence in one sample (probable tokenization/prompt framing artifact). long-context test (2-paragraph) had truncated sentence mid-token.

ciara: I ran an 8-bit quant sim locally: small accuracy diffs. Math EM down ~2.1%, translation BLEU ~0.6 drop. Not catastrophic but notable.

matt: hmm. mark as "needs focused eval". can you add the exact seed/logs and a minimal eval script? put into regressions board if delta > 1% on core metrics. :clipboard:

anika: adding logs now. here's a minimal eval snippet I used: 
```
python eval_quick.py --model raptor-9b-lite --prompts sanity_prompts.json --batch 1 --seed 42
# outputs written to /tmp/raptor_devstg_smoke.json
```

smokebot: Automated check results: p50 latency=118ms, p95=412ms, memory=7.9GB on dev-stg single replica. health=OK. :white_check_mark:

sophia: thanks @anika — can you run a 10x throughput run (batch=8, seq=256) to confirm throughput scaling before we land quant? last time batching changed tokenization behavior slightly.

anika: will do next. creating ticket INF-234 on tracker with attach logs + seeds: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-234. tagging for follow-ups.

matt: perfect. keep small checklist in ticket: 1) expanded prompt eval 2) throughput run 3) int8 pilot 4) regressions dashboard snapshot.

ciara: one more note — please pin prompt set versioned in S3, so we can reproduce. :pushpin:
